name: Reacquisition of Moldovan Citizenship (redobandire) (Law No. 253/2025, Art. 13)

qualifying_event.description: For persons who previously HELD Moldovan citizenship and lost it (typically through renunciation), as distinct from md_citizenship_by_descent.json which covers descendants who never held Moldovan citizenship themselves.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Documentation of prior Moldovan citizenship and the circumstances of its loss.

requirements.blocker_text: Previously held Moldovan citizenship and lost it, most commonly through renunciation.
Demonstrated knowledge of the Romanian language and constitutional provisions (or documented disability exemption), and must not fall under Art. 19 refusal grounds.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the required language/civics exam (ANCE certificate) or obtain a disability exemption.

evidence_required.document: Romanian language exam certificate (ANCE) or disability documentation

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: applications may be filed in-country at ASP Chisinau or abroad via diplomatic missions/consulates -- no minimum physical presence period is stated

sources.title: Public Services Agency (ASP), Republic of Moldova -- reacquisition of citizenship (redobandire) service page: prior citizenship + loss via renunciation, Romanian language/civics requirement (ANCE certificate) or disability exemption, no bar under Art. 19 refusal grounds, processing up to 1 year (extendable 6 months for document verification), fee 6,650 MDL per Law No. 213/2023

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Moldova). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- directly fetched and confirmed from ASP.gov.md, Moldova's own Public Services Agency, tier-1. This is the ONE Moldovan citizenship file in this build sourced independently to a government page rather than the tier-4 PDF mirror used elsewhere -- the other citizenship files (naturalisation, marriage, descent/recognition, special grounds) rest on weaker sourcing and should not be assumed equally solid. Distinct from md_citizenship_by_descent.json: reacquisition (redobandire) is for people who THEMSELVES previously held and lost Moldovan citizenship; recognition (recunoastere) is for descendants who never held it. Processing time (up to 1 year, extendable 6 months) is unusually slow compared to most naturalisation-adjacent routes in this dataset.
